metadata.description: Update the stage edit permissions for a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Update the stage edit permissions for a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify which users or teams have access to edit stages within a specified pipeline. It is useful for managing access control and ensuring that only authorized personnel can make changes to the pipeline stages.

objectTypeId.label: Object Type Id
objectTypeId.description: The unique identifier of the object type associated with the pipeline.

pipelineId.label: Pipeline Id
pipelineId.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline for which stage edit permissions are being updated.

stages.label: Stages
stages.description: An array of stage permission requests, each defined by the PublicStagePermissionRequest schema. This property specifies the permissions to be updated for each stage in the pipeline.
